text:
emma_support: heads-up: acme-prod reporting a spike of 503/500s on hosted inference since ~02:04 UTC. Customer says retries -> timeouts, large tail latency. Root looks like upstream worker exits. Pasting snippets below.

emma_support: error samples from customer:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
{"error":"upstream inference worker crashed","code":503}
```

lisa_oncall: thanks — can you grab the failing pod name + last 200 lines of logs and any kube events? also which model + route they hit?

emma_support: route: /v1/generate -> model redwood-7b (hosted). Pod: hosted-runner-5f8b7d9c6b-gtlz2. logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-17T02:03:58Z] INFO incoming request id=req_abc123 tokens=~1800 batch_size=8
[2026-03-17T02:04:12Z] WARN GPU memory high: used=46.9GB total=48GB
[2026-03-17T02:04:15Z] ERROR segfault at 0x7f8c... decoding step
[2026-03-17T02:04:15Z] FATAL caught signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
[2026-03-17T02:04:16Z] INFO runtime exiting, cleaning up
```

raj_infra: kube events for that node (gke-host-12):
```
Mar 17 02:04:16 node kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 23456 (runner) total-vm:123456kB, anon-rss:482344kB, file-rss:0kB
Mar 17 02:04:16 nvidia: NVRM: Xid (GPU) 13: PID 23456: GPU page fault or ECC error
Mar 17 02:04:17 kubelet: Pod hosted-runner-5f8b7d9c6b-gtlz2 evicted, reason: OOMKilled
```

raj_infra: i also saw repeated container restarts: restartCount jumped from 0 -> 5 in ~3m, which explains the 503 surge.

miguel_runtime: this matches a pattern we've seen: long prompts + continuous batching + large KV cache growth -> kernel/GPU memory pressure -> segfault/oom. Note batch_size=8 + tokens~1800 on a 48GB card is pushing the limits, especially with KV retained per request.

miguel_runtime: quick repro steps i used in staging (will reproduce within ~2-3 runs):
```
# repeat 10x in parallel to reproduce backpressure/oom
curl -s -X POST https://hosted.api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"'$(python -c 'print("\nLONG_PROMPT\n"*1000)')'","max_tokens":1500}'
```
response will be 503 after the worker crashes.

carlos_sre: immediate mitigations we can do right now:
- set routing policy to reduce batch target to 1 for the affected pool
- route heavy-token requests to a quantized 8-bit variant (redwood-7b-q8)
- increase node pool capacity / cordon faulty node until we rebuild

carlos_sre: config change proposal (canary):
```
# canary: hosted-pool config
inference.default_batch: 1
inference.kv_cache_max_tokens: 1024
routing.fallback_model: redwood-7b-q8
```
deploy-bot: started rollout job #4321 -> canary change (hosting: hosted-runner-pool). Canary target: 3 pods.

lisa_oncall: also add a short-term watch for Xid codes and oom-killer on nodes (alert when Xid >= 3 in 10m). We want to avoid noisy restarts triggering gateway 503s.

miguel_runtime: longer-term fixes:
- early reject requests when predicted KV growth exceeds threshold (reject w/ 429 or smaller prompt guidance)
- add per-request soft-cgroup limit for GPU allocations so one request can't take the whole card
- trim/evict KV cache aggressively for single-hosted tenants on low-tier pools

miguel_runtime: patch idea (quick): add runtime flag `--max-kv-bytes=20GB` and make batching logic consult `estimated_kv` when forming batches. If combined estimate > limit -> split batch.

emma_support: i've informed acme support contact (Sara) and opened INC-2043. Offering 10% service credit for the spike window and will pause traffic into the affected pool while canary rolls. Sara asked for an ETA; we said ~30-45m for mitigation then follow-up.

lisa_oncall: action items:
- [raj_infra] cordon node gke-host-12 + drain after canary finishes (priority)
- [carlos_sre/miguel_runtime] force canary batch=1 + enable fallback model (in 5m)
- [emma_support] customer notice & credits (done)
- [miguel_runtime] follow-up patch PR for `--max-kv-bytes` (target EOD)

carlos_sre: once canary is stable we'll scale pool up and uncordon nodes. keep monitoring token-level latency and OOM alerts.

emma_support: thanks all. tagging this thread to INC-2043 and will update customer after canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary job #4321 completed (3/3 pods healthy) at 02:34 UTC, batch-size=1 applied.

lisa_oncall: observing 503s drop by ~95% after canary. still watching for any residual Xid events. will keep channel updated.

miguel_runtime: adding repro artifact and minimal stack trace to PR: "segfault in decode_step at decode.c:421 - likely nvrtc memory mishandle under extreme KV growth"

emma_support: closing loop: customer accepted credit and temporary routing, asked for root-cause postmortem. assigning owner: miguel_runtime for RCA + SRE to validate infra mitigations.
